summary_en: Japan Post Insurance authorized acquisition of up to 50 million shares (4.6% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥47 billion via ToSTNeT-3 and open market purchases from November 16, 2026 through March 31, 2027, to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns while maintaining Japan Post's voting ratio at or below 50%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Japan Post Insurance's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 50 million shares of its own common stock for a maximum expenditure of ¥47 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction trading) and open market purchases between November 16, 2026 and March 31, 2027. This represents 4.6% of outstanding shares, calculated on the basis of issued shares excluding treasury stock.

The company stated that the buyback aims to enhance capital efficiency and strengthen shareholder returns as part of its medium-term management plan targeting a consolidated payout ratio of approximately 55% over the medium term. The timing and scale are coordinated with the parent company Japan Post's concurrent sales of company shares. Japan Post, which currently holds approximately 49.8% of voting rights, is obligated by the Postal Privatization Law to maintain ownership exceeding one-third of issued shares but intends to continue reducing its stake. Through this coordinated buyback and parent company share sales, the company will work to maintain Japan Post's voting ratio at or below 50%.

The board confirmed that this transaction does not constitute a condition materially different from normal market terms, as the acquisition will occur through public trading venues available to all shareholders at equal prices. The transaction was approved unanimously by all ten directors without conflicts of interest, including seven outside directors.
